name: Omni-SafetyBench
description: Omni-SafetyBench is the first comprehensive benchmark for safety evaluation of omni-modal large language models (OLLMs) integrating audio, visual, and text inputs. It includes 24 modality variations with 972 samples each and introduces novel metrics to assess safety and cross-modal consistency under complex multi-modal inputs.
reputation: A newly introduced safety benchmark for omni-modal LLMs that is notable for covering audio, visual, and text inputs with cross-modal consistency checks.
notes: Addresses safety challenges unique to omni-modal inputs and evaluates multiple open- and closed-source OLLMs.
